{"findings":[{"rule_id":"MF-005","evidence":[{"kind":"title_block","ref":"heat_treatment","page":1,"quote":"---"},{"kind":"note","ref":"N2","page":1,"quote":"HEAT TREATMENT NOTE :-
1) TO BE CASE HARDENED UPTO 55~60 HRC.
2) CASE DEPTH 0.8~1.2mm.
3) THREADS TO BE KEEP SOFT.
4) RETAPPING TO BE DONE AFTER SURFACE TREATMENT AT SUPPLIER END.( IF APPLICABLE )"}],"comment":"The title block heat_treatment field states '---', contradicting note N2 which specifies case hardening to 55–60 HRC with a 0.8–1.2 mm case depth. This conflict can cause the part to be manufactured without the required hardness, leading to premature wear or failure. The designer should update the title block heat_treatment field to match the requirements in note N2."
    ,
    "recommended_correction":"Update the title block heat_treatment field from '---' to reflect the case hardening specified in N2."}]}
